vmaf.location: private developer cache, not production installation

tests.scope: probe inputs/runtime/worker unit, runtime+recipes integration (real systemd/Landlock/seccomp + real tools), tests/integration/lib/test_audio_utils.py, tests/unit/r2/quality, scope guard unit, 2 format_validation snapshot regressions
tests.interval_stability: intervals case 5/5 repeated passes; metadata-file detector output identical across 20 runs
tests.vmaf: same1==same2 measurement digest; changed reference differs and FAILs threshold; all spans exactly 5 frames; raw scratch sizes 64*64*3/2*5

semantics.host_validator_parity: format_validation.media_facts/decode_errors agree on width/height/codec/fps/duration/audio/decode-clean for qualified CFR fixtures; probe is narrower: forces MP4 demuxer, file-only protocol, avg_frame_rate, refuses non-h264/aac/yuv420p and truncated containers (existing validator counts decode errors instead)
semantics.intervals: read from metadata=mode=print files per filter graph; FFmpeg 8 log lines interleave across filter threads and were observed dropping silence_end
semantics.loudness: SILENT when true peak -inf or integrated equals ebur128 gate floor -70.0; non-finite otherwise UNMEASURABLE; no audio stream UNMEASURABLE
semantics.errors: malformed/truncated/unsupported media and invalid captions -> M10_PROBE_FAILED; incomparable/absent/insufficient reference -> M10_REFERENCE_INVALID; changed tool/model -> M10_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING; output ceiling -> M10_OPERATIONAL_ENVELOPE_EXCEEDED

limitations: Tiny fixtures qualify mechanism only; no cohort threshold calibrated.
VMAF and kernel cases need the private VMAF cache and a systemd user manager; they fail rather than skip elsewhere.
Snapshot/scratch roots use tempfile (tmpfs on this host); Task5 makes the root host-configurable.
